welcome.headline: A place to keep track of what's actually happening to you.
welcome.body: EMBR helps you turn what you're experiencing into something you can look back on, understand, and eventually bring into a conversation with your doctor. It doesn't diagnose you or replace your clinician. It helps you organize your own record, on your own terms.

jobToBeDone.headline: What do you want EMBR to help you with?
jobToBeDone.hint: This just shapes what we show you first. You can always change your mind later.
jobToBeDone.keepRecord: Keep a better record, long term

whatsGoingOn.headline: What have you noticed lately?
whatsGoingOn.hint: Pick anything that's felt different. This isn't a log yet. It just helps your first check-in feel like it already knows you.

appointmentStatus.headline: Do you have a healthcare appointment coming up?
appointmentStatus.hint: No need for the exact date yet. Just helps us know whether to keep BRIEF close at hand.
appointmentStatus.unsureWhen: Yes, but I'm not sure when

theLoop.headline: Here's how EMBR works.
theLoop.patternsTitle: Once you've logged for a couple of weeks, you might see something like:
theLoop.patternsExample: "Your sleep disruption appeared alongside lower energy on 6 days."
theLoop.patternsCaveat: Descriptive, not diagnostic. EMBR never tells you what's causing something.
theLoop.briefBody: A structured summary of your record, built when you're ready. Not automatically.
theLoop.conversationTitle: Something concrete to bring into your next appointment.
